import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,base64
l=pathlib.Path.cwd();policy=json.loads((l/'manifest-policy.json').read_text());excluded=set(policy['terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions'])
assert json.loads((l/'frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
ids=json.loads((l/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];assert set(json.loads((l/'keyedresults.json').read_text()))==set(map(str,ids))
for p in json.loads((l/'original-provenance.json').read_text()):
 raw=base64.b64decode(p['raw_base64']); assert (l/'literals'/f"{p['id']}.jsonl").read_bytes()==raw;assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256']
previous='0'*64
for seq,raw in enumerate((l/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)):
 e=json.loads(raw);assert e['seq']==seq and e['previous']==previous;previous=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
for n in [1,2,3]:
 s=json.loads((l/f'search-response-{n}.json').read_text());assert isinstance(s,str) and len(s)>100
files=[]
for p in sorted(l.rglob('*')):
 assert not p.is_symlink(),str(p)
 if not p.is_file():continue
 name=p.relative_to(l).as_posix()
 if name in excluded:continue
 files.append((name,hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
manifest=''.join(f'{h}  {n}\n' for n,h in files)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(l/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.sha256'],input=manifest,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print(json.dumps({'sealed_files':len(files),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(manifest.encode()).hexdigest(),'completed_receipts_in_manifest':[n for n,h in files if n.endswith('receipt.json')],'terminal_self_exclusions':sorted(excluded),'frozen_after':'PASS12','provenance_and_guard_chain':'PASS','search_responses':'ALL3 complete returned JSON strings retained','qualified_survivors':0,'accepted_credit':0}))
